verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a SaaS equity-management platform could ship an in-product AI assistant. The pack contains no evidence of one. The AI evidence describes Claude plugins and an MCP server that let an external LLM query Carta data. That is an external-agent integration belonging to the MCP story, not a built-in assistant users delegate tasks to inside Carta.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
